secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<ref>.supabase.co). Find in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key. Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public. Safe to expose in the browser.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key. Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → service_role. Server-only, never exposed to the browser.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_TOKEN
secrets.description: Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API access token (optional — only needed for the WhatsApp game bot). Get it from the Meta App Dashboard > WhatsApp > API Setup.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
secrets.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID (optional — paired with WHATSAPP_TOKEN). From the Meta App Dashboard > WhatsApp > API Setup.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Meta app secret used to verify X-Hub-Signature-256 on webhooks (optional). From the Meta App Dashboard > App Settings > Basic.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI (Gemini) API key for duplicate-question detection (optional). From Google AI Studio at aistudio.google.com.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (optional, reserved — not required for the core game). From platform.openai.com.
